_: The King's decrees as data (consolidation B5): what each costs (in hundreds of crowns), its name, and what it does in a few words for the town card (effect; courtEffect when ordered at his own seat). crown.js decides what happens; the view shows these words, never its own.

relief.label: Send grain to a starving town

grant.label: Grant this castle to another house

feast.label: Hold a feast in the lord's honour

marriage.label: Arrange a marriage between two houses

peace.label: Command peace between two warring houses

ward.label: Take a house's heir as a royal ward

back.label: Back one side of a war

settle.label: Tell another house to settle a war

alliance.label: Swear an alliance with a house

march.label: March the royal host on a house's town
